name: bun-warmer
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm with a periodic ping for sessions with a large context, counts subagent work as activity, never blocks a prompt a human did not type, flags silent subagents, and writes an informational state file. Inspired by cache-tax by Karan Bansal (MIT).

intervalMin.title: Ping interval (minutes)
intervalMin.description: Minutes of quiet before a ping. Default 50; the cache goes cold after 60, so values above 55 are capped. Env BUN_WARMER_INTERVAL_MIN overrides.

windowMin.title: Window (minutes)
windowMin.description: How long pings continue after the last human prompt. Default 90. Env BUN_WARMER_WINDOW_MIN overrides; env BUN_WARMER_WINDOW_HOURS (if set) overrides both.

minTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minTokens.description: Ping and show the cold-cache warning only for sessions whose context is at least this many tokens. Default 50000. A session whose size is not yet known is not pinged. Env BUN_WARMER_MIN_TOKENS overrides.

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: warn only shows a note when you type a prompt into a cold session. refuse drops your own first send once. Never applies to subagent or other non-human prompts.
